observations: Yellow motorcycle with black accents, shown from side, front, and rear angles.
Engine cover has a visible 'B' logo, possibly indicating a Bajaj brand.
Front fairing has a red 'Yamaha' logo, but it appears faded and possibly applied as a sticker or decal.
Front headlight is dirty and hazy, with visible cracks or damage on the lens.
Front tire is worn, with low tread depth and visible damage on the sidewall.
Front fork and suspension appear dirty and possibly damaged; front fender is cracked.
Wiring near the front is exposed and messy, with visible loose wires and connectors.
Rear section shows a black seat with textured surface, and the engine is partially exposed.
The motorcycle is in a workshop or repair environment, with tools and parts scattered on the ground.
The seller's text is in Hausa: 'Yanada karfi ga gudu ga tafiya ga ba shan me' — meaning 'Good condition, clean, well-maintained, no issues'.

read_from: photo 2: red 'Yamaha' logo on front fairing

claims.claim: Good condition, clean, well-maintained, no issues
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows exposed and messy wiring, cracked front fender, and worn front tire. Photo 2 shows a cracked headlight lens and damaged front tire. Photo 0 shows dirt and grime on the engine and body. These indicate poor condition and maintenance.

risks.proof: Video or photo of the engine running, or close-up of the engine internals and oil level.
Close-up photo of front fork seals and stanchions, and test ride video.

risks.risk: Electrical system faults due to exposed wiring
risks.proof: Photo of the wiring harness and battery connections, and test of lights and ignition.
Close-up photo of front tire tread and sidewall damage.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing immediate tire replacement

proof_requests: Video of the motorcycle starting and running smoothly.
Close-up of the front fork seals and stanchions.
Photo of the battery and wiring harness connections.
Photo of the front tire tread and sidewall damage.
Photo of the engine oil level and condition.
response.reason: The motorcycle appears to be in poor condition with visible damage to the front tire, headlight, fender, and exposed wiring. The seller's claim of good condition is contradicted by the photos. Without proof of engine functionality, electrical integrity, and suspension condition, a worst-case price cannot be determined. Further proof is required to assess the true value.
